labelHint: The step appears under this name in the run and in placeholders.

condition.text: Checks a result with fixed rules and opens the matching branches. No AI request is made.
condition.sourceHint: Empty: the result that arrives through the incoming connection.
condition.onInvalid: When the result cannot be checked
condition.unconnected: Not connected yet: {{names}}. Drag from the branch's dot to an agent.

rule.label: Branch name
rule.fieldHint: A field of the structured result, e.g. category or customer.tier. Empty: the whole result.

approval.text: Stops the run until a person approves or rejects the results. Nothing is ever approved automatically.
approval.instructionsHint: What should the reviewer pay attention to?
approval.showHint: Nothing selected: everything that arrives here.
approval.allowCommentHint: Later agents can read the comment under the name of this step.
approval.requireComment: A comment is required when rejecting
approval.never: Open approvals survive a restart. Schedules, batches and test series wait for a decision too.

subworkflow.text: Runs another saved workflow as one step. It runs as its own, linked run.
subworkflow.versionHint: A fixed version does not change when the workflow is edited later.
subworkflow.inputHint: What the sub-workflow gets as its input. {{input}} is what arrives here.
subworkflow.valuesHint: Text or placeholders such as {{formExample}} or {{agentExample}}.
subworkflow.costs: The sub-workflow's cost and tokens count once, in the run of this workflow.

form.title: Input form
form.empty: Without fields the start dialog shows a free text box. With fields it asks for exactly these values.
form.hint: Agents read the values through placeholders such as {{example}}.
form.label: Label
form.name: Technical name
form.runIntro: Fill in the workflow's input form.
form.extraInputHint: Appended to the input after the form values.
form.requiredHint: The run starts only when the field is filled in.
form.optionalHint: May stay empty: agents then see that nothing was given (decisions can check “is empty”).

files.title: Result files
files.hint: At the end of the run this node also writes its result as a file. Without an entry no file is written.
files.name: File name
files.none: No files yet. Create one from the result, or add files to the result node.
files.afterRun: Files are written once the run has ended.
files.csvHint: CSV needs a list of records or an object of simple values.

contract.title: Output contract
contract.hint: The workflow promises these fields as its result. At the end, the result is checked for them; other fields are left out. A parent workflow can rely on them.
contract.none: Without a contract, the workflow passes its result on unchanged. With a contract, it delivers a checked object with fixed fields as a team.

run.decisionReused: taken over from the earlier run
run.reused: This result was taken over from the earlier run and not computed again.

origin.api: Started through the published API (version {{number}}, key {{key}}).
origin.apiStudio: Test run of the published API (version {{number}}) from Nodestro.

resume.title: Continue run
resume.intro: A new, linked run takes over the results that are still valid and runs the rest again. The failed run stays as it was.
resume.summary: {{reused}} steps are taken over, {{rerun}} run again. Saved: about {{saved}}.

reasons.no_fingerprint: The earlier run holds no fingerprint for this step.
reasons.was_blocked: Did not run because of an error before it.
reasons.in_loop: Part of a loop: the whole loop runs again.

resume.confirmHint: These steps had already called tools. Check whether a second call triggers something twice (e.g. a message).
